0.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_1
0.description: Ho there! I know an adventurer after an elite mark when I see one!

3.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_A1_000_2
3.description: Tell me about the rank B elite mark. (Bloody Mary)

4.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_A1_000_3
4.description: Tell me about the rank A elite mark. (Hellsclaw)

5.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_A1_000_4
5.description: Tell me about the rank S elite mark. (The Garlok)

7.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_10
7.description: Many wonder that. Why, I could have been anything! But a hunter I am, and a keeper of peace. Not so bad in the scheme of things.

8.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_11
8.description: Hunting elite marks makes for a comfortable life, I'll warrant, if you're any good─as I am! The bounty is paid in Allied Seals, a harder currency than most in these unsettled times.

9.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_12
9.description: Now, a young thing like yourself would need someone older and wiser to show you the ropes! Which elite mark do you fancy, <hex:020844E905FF186D79206C616479206661697220616E6420666965726365FF276D7920737472617070696E6720616E642077656C6C021F0103666F726D656420667269656E6403>?

10.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_13
10.description: By the by, never let dreams of wealth and glory blind you to the danger. Know your ranks: B is the least, S is the most, and a merry chase a rank S mark would lead, too.

11.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_20
11.description: “Bloody Mary is oft cited as the example of an unstoppable force─Qiqirn gluttony─meeting an immovable object─maternal love. Such characterization would not pass muster beyond the confines of a winesink, however, and is known to provoke dissent even in those establishments.

12.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_21
12.description: “While Bloody Mary is indeed an apkallu whose eggs suffered Qiqirn predation, nesting hens as a rule do not spear a failed egg thief a score and a half times with their beaks, then proceed to bathe in their victim's blood.”

13.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_30
13.description: “Hellsclaw. So erratic yet bloody a swath has this piece of magitek cut across the region that it is suspected of being sadly afflicted in some way.”

14.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_31
14.description: So much for the infallibility of Garlean technology, eh? Hard to be afraid of a wheel that needs truing, I know, but be careful all the same.

15.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_40
15.description: “A monster long said to dwell in the eternal twilight of a cavern, the Garlok was but an idle tale for generations of Bloodshore's children.

16.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_41
16.description: “However, one child was ill content to be idle, and his name was Gegeruju, the Master of Costa del Sol. At his command, a party entered the cavern in search of the Garlok...”

17.name: TEXT_REGSEANOTORIOUSMONSTERHINTF3_00185_MOBHUNTERS1F3_000_42
17.description: Well, you get the idea. They found the beast slumbering sheltered from the rain, and they woke the damn thing up. Suffice to say it's more than a mite annoyed at being roused so rudely.
